u0: Initial/blocked state: the ball is still on the cell in front of the locked door, so blocker_moved has not been achieved, the door is closed, and the target box is unreachable. Clear the blocker first by picking up the ball and dropping it away from the door; avoid picking up the matching key before this if possible, because carrying the key prevents moving the ball and dropping the key while the door is closed triggers key_lost and a penalty. If already carrying the key, the next useful progress still requires freeing your hands and clearing the ball.
u1: Progress: blocker_moved has been achieved at least once and the door has not been opened; the matching key is not currently held in this state. Ensure the ball is actually off the door-approach cell—if it was dropped back there, move it away again and put it down well away from the door—then locate and pick up the key matching the door color. Once holding the key, keep it and go to the door; do not drop it while the door remains closed.
u2: Progress: blocker_moved and has_door_key have both been achieved, but the door has not yet been opened. If the matching key is still in hand and the door approach is clear, go to the door and toggle it open; if you lost or dropped the key while the door was closed, reacquire it first, and if the ball has been dropped back in front of the door, clear it again before trying. Avoid dropping the matching key while the door is closed, since that fires key_lost, gives a penalty, and leaves you in this state.
u3: Progress: door_open has been achieved and the target box has not yet been picked up. Head into the target room, locate the box named in the mission, and pick it up; if the door was shut again, reopen it first. If you are still carrying the matching key, drop it to free your hands only while the door is open—or reopen it first—because dropping it while the door is closed would fire key_lost even though door progress is not lost.
u4: Terminal success: the agent is carrying the mission's designated target box, so target_picked_up is true and the episode ends. The objective is complete; no further subgoal remains.
